confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cebu price levels; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Cocktail and wine are set from beer-relative multiples (about 2.9x and 3.2x the beer anchor) because direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation is least certain and varies by area (Cebu City vs Mactan), platform and lead time; figures assume typical July rates in the rainy season, including taxes and usual mandatory charges. The FX value comes from search-result excerpts of rba.gov.au exchange-rate pages, not a directly opened page, so verify it against the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparison city. Priced against general knowledge of Philippine regional tourist hubs, mainly Cebu City and Mactan visitor areas; no comparison page or live listing was consulted.
